lines.text: Five merchant houses. One desert bazaar. And every merchant is an NFT that owns its own NEAR wallet.
Your house is a charter on NEAR testnet. Its wallet holds real testnet NEAR, its stock is on-chain tokens, and its record changes as the business lives or dies.
Four rival houses think for themselves. They read the rumors, race you for Palace orders, and remember who insulted them.
Haggle with any of them. Every deal settles through an escrow contract: goods and payment move in one transaction.
Then, on day six, a magnate arrives with deep pockets and no goodwill. He sells below cost until the bazaar breaks. <short pause> Then he owns it.
So fight back. Rally the rivals into a pact, buy off his carts, borrow from the Moneylenders' Guild, and keep your customers loyal.
Make it not worth his gold, and he leaves. Every loan, deal and takeover along the way is a real transaction.
Seize three charters, and become Sovereign of the Bazaar. <short pause> Play free at bazaar dot reconscribe dot com.
